citation.authors: Wolf AMD, Hoffman RM, Walter LC et al
citation.journal: CA: A Cancer Journal for Clinicians

cited_by.title: Colonoscopy: when to start and how often

record.population: US average-risk adults, American Cancer Society 2026 update
record.design: Guideline update from a targeted evidence review and modelling
record.finding: The ACS reaffirms starting at 45 and continuing to 75 for those with a life expectancy over 10 years, and says a positive result on any non-colonoscopy test needs timely follow-up colonoscopy, preferably within 6 months.
